tasks.short: Develop application data models, metadata tables, views and related structures.

steps.what: Define the actual entities, grain, relationships, keys, constraints and view meaning with data owners
Create database definition statements and metadata entries from the explicit checked logical model
inputs: target database dialect and naming rules

steps.what: Validate candidate definitions against actual grain, relationship semantics, null behaviour, permissions and representative query results in an isolated test environment
inputs: approved test fixtures and expected results
outputs: validated model definitions v1 and test evidence

steps.what: Review the exact validated model definitions v1, test evidence and intended internal design-repository destination
inputs: validated model definitions v1 and test evidence

steps.what: Commit the exact approved model design package v1 to the internal design repository

tasks.design: Configure the native model-to-definition generator in the database modelling environment {OTHER}, using an explicit architect-designed model for {DATA_PLATFORM}. The architect retains semantic design and substantive isolated validation, reviews the complete package and commits it separately; no production schema is changed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explicit models can still require repeated dialect-specific definition and metadata typing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native model generators can emit definitions from fully specified structures.
tasks.still_hard: Correct grain, relationships and data meaning cannot be inferred from table names.
tasks.human_edge: Identify a technically valid schema that misrepresents the business concept.
tasks.altitude: Less definition typing with the same model and validation responsibility.

reach.learn: Agree grain and key semantics before generating definitions.

evidence.claim: Native modelling tools can emit database definitions from an explicit model; semantic decisions remain with the architect.

assumptions: Boundary is design-package development and isolated tests, not production migration or a release approval. {OTHER} denotes database modelling and version-control tools. Shares are provisional, not measured.

Architect and data owners produce entity/column names, types, nullability, key/cardinality rules, grain, view expressions, permissions and target dialect in s1. Architect supplies fixtures and expected query meanings in s3. Missing semantic decisions are resolved manually before generation; no free inferred schema.
Native generator first. Existing automated compilation/runtime earns no human saving; only manual definition typing shrinks. Same-repository commit retains full ordinary effort.
unknowns: Actual manual definition effort and validation needs
research_questions: Can the installed generator preserve target dialect and all specified constraints without extra repair?

already_counted.description: Check generated definitions against explicit model fields.
Substantive model validation and actual query-result checks.

incremental.description: Maintain generation settings after dialect or naming changes.

approvals.approved_version: approved model design package v1 including exact definitions/tests and repository destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native generation removes 15 of the provisional 25 manual definition hours less 1 upkeep. Highly customised views leave more manual repair; logical design, validation, final review and commit remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design database interfaces, transfer mechanisms, temporary tables, partitions and function-based indexes.

steps.what: Specify actual workload, access semantics, transfer guarantees, isolation, permissions and performance constraints
Write candidate database application definitions, transfer logic or index/partition structures for the explicit design intent

loop.purpose: Draft implementation code for an architect-specified design.
loop.input: Exact design intent, schemas, dialect, interface contract, transaction and rollback requirements.
loop.output: Candidate code and definitions with explicit unsupported assumptions.
loop.check: Architect reviews operation meaning, joins, null semantics, transaction boundaries, data exposure, retry behaviour and rollback against intended behaviour; compilation alone is insufficient.
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unknown semantics or unsafe operations return to manual coding.
loop.why_not_simpler: Try native wizards first; custom access and transfer logic can require code beyond fixed templates.

steps.what: Test candidate behaviour and representative performance in isolation, including transfer failure, retries, permissions and rollback
Review the exact validated database application package v1 and its internal design-repository destination
Commit the exact approved database application package v1 to the internal design repository

tasks.design: Test native {DATA_PLATFORM} configuration and definition wizards first; for remaining custom logic use a bounded draft in the development environment {OTHER}. The architect specifies behaviour, reviews code meaning and performs isolated correctness/failure/performance tests before approving the complete package for a separate repository commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Custom database mechanisms require implementation beyond native wizards.
tasks.enabler_now: A constrained code draft can start from explicit contracts without owning architectural choices.
tasks.still_hard: Real workload trade-offs, concurrency and failure semantics require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Reject an efficient-looking design that loses data or changes access meaning.
tasks.altitude: Less initial code typing, with architecture and acceptance unchanged.

reach.learn: Specify retries, duplicate handling and expected data semantics.

evidence.claim: A bounded coding assistant can draft database implementation code from explicit requirements, subject to substantive review.

assumptions: Boundary is candidate design and isolated validation, not a production migration or data sync. {OTHER} is the development editor/version-control environment. Shares are provisional.

Architect produces actual workload/query evidence, schemas, operation intent, partition/index expressions, permissions, transfer consistency and rollback requirements. Source owners supply actual interface contracts. Architect manually resolves gaps and defines approved fixtures and expected outcomes; tests are not generated from undocumented assumptions.
Native configuration first. All semantic design and independent validation remain full. Existing test runtime and same-repository commit earn no labour saving.
unknowns: Native wizard coverage and actual custom code share
Availability of representative safe workload fixtures
research_questions: Does reviewed draft code reduce total typing and repair while passing the same independent behavioural tests?

already_counted.description: Independent behaviour, failure and performance acceptance.

incremental.description: Maintain draft context and restrictions when dialect/contracts change.

approvals.approved_version: approved database application package v1 and exact internal repository destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Explicit custom logic permits 14 of the provisional 35 coding hours to disappear less 1.5 upkeep. Difficult concurrency or dialect cases need more manual repair; design, independent tests, final review and commit remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop methods to integrate products and customise commercial databases.

steps.what: Develop the method for integrating the actual source and destination products and customising the commercial database: field meanings, ownership, authentication, transformation and failure/reconciliation requirements
inputs: actual source and destination interface documentation

steps.what: Build the specified product connector mappings and commercial database customisation configuration from the explicit integration contract
Validate the candidate integration method in isolation against actual source/destination semantics, retries, duplicate handling, failure recovery and reconciliation
inputs: approved test fixtures and expected outcomes

steps.what: Check the exact validated integration method package v1 and internal repository destination
Commit the exact approved integration method package v1 to the internal design repository

tasks.design: Configure supported native {DATA_PLATFORM} connectors from an architect-authored contract rather than rewriting transport and mapping scaffolding. The architect retains field-meaning decisions and isolated integration acceptance, then approves and commits the complete method package in version control {OTHER}; no live transfer or deployment occurs within this design task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supported interfaces can still be joined with repeated connector boilerplate.
tasks.enabler_now: Native connectors can provide specified transport/mapping structure when interfaces are supported.
tasks.still_hard: Semantic mismatches, ownership and partial-failure handling need an explicit integration design.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when apparently matching fields represent different business events.
tasks.altitude: Less connector scaffolding, with contract and acceptance responsibility unchanged.

reach.task: Integrate source data into warehouse structures
reach.learn: Agree event semantics and reconciliation, not only column names.

evidence.claim: Supported native connectors can reduce repeated transport and mapping scaffolding from explicit contracts.

assumptions: Boundary is developing and testing the integration method, not operating a production integration or counting another team's future rekey savings. Shares are provisional; {OTHER} is version control.

System owners supply actual versioned schemas, field definitions, supported endpoints, authentication scope and examples. Architect produces mapping predicates, transformations, transaction/event semantics, retry/idempotency and reconciliation requirements in s1, and manually supplies expected test outcomes in s3. Missing semantics require owner clarification.

Try native supported connectors first. Custom unsupported interfaces remain manual rather than receiving the assumed native saving. Existing runtime and same-repository commit earn no human saving; no free source feed is created.
unknowns: Native connector support for actual endpoints
Actual transport scaffolding versus semantic design effort
research_questions: Does the native connector handle specified failure/retry cases without custom repair?

already_counted.description: Check and repair native connector configuration against the explicit mapping contract.
Independent integration behaviour and reconciliation tests.

incremental.description: Maintain connector templates after interface-version changes.

approvals.approved_version: approved integration method package v1 and exact internal destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Supported native connectors remove 12.5 of the provisional 25 scaffold/configuration hours less 1 upkeep. Unsupported interfaces offer less benefit; contract decisions, acceptance tests, final check and commit remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create and enforce database development standards.

steps.what: Create the actual database development standards, define rationale and decide which requirements are objectively checkable
outputs: complete development standards and explicit predicates

steps.what: Implement the explicit checkable standards as native schema/code checks and validate pass/fail examples
inputs: complete development standards and explicit predicates

steps.what: Review the exact completed standards and check package v1, examples and permitted advisory enforcement scope
inputs: complete development standards and explicit predicates

steps.what: Publish the exact approved standards/check package v1 to the named internal development-policy and advisory-check locations
Compare actual proposed database changes with the published explicit standards and review all check findings
Resolve noncheckable design issues and disputed findings with developers and decide permitted exceptions
outputs: actual exception decisions and corrective guidance

tasks.design: Configure native schema linters and advisory pipeline checks in the development environment {OTHER} for predicates authored by the architect, alongside the policy in {DOCS}. Publish only after review of the completed package; fixed checks reduce manual comparison, while all noncheckable design judgements and exception decisions stay human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explicit conventions can still be inspected manually in each proposed database change.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linters and schema assertions can repeat agreed checks without interpreting policy text.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a standard is appropriate and an exception justified remains architectural judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a justified exception from a brittle rule or a real design risk.

ambition.what: Review fixed-standard findings for each proposed database change before deciding whether an exception needs attention.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated syntax/convention comparison, with standard-setting and exception rights unchanged.

reach.learn: Translate an agreed objective requirement into an explicit predicate and counterexample.

evidence.claim: Native schema linters and assertions can apply explicit conventions while exception judgement remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is standards authorship, advisory checks and exception discussion. This creates no automatic merge block, deployment or staff-performance score. {OTHER} is version control and the development pipeline. Shares are provisional.

Architect produces exact predicates such as required naming patterns, prohibited types and explicit constraint requirements, including pass/fail fixtures and exceptions in s1/s2. Developers produce actual proposed schema/code changes. Missing policy meaning is resolved manually; no model translates vague standards into binding checks.

Test native linters first. Savings apply only to manual check implementation scaffolding and repeated comparison, not existing automated runtime. Noncheckable standards and exception decisions retain full effort. Any separate approval record or merge action must be separately gated if added.
unknowns: Current manual comparison and existing automated checks
Native checker coverage and false-positive workload
research_questions: Which explicit conventions still require manual comparison and can be checked natively without extra false-positive work?

already_counted.description: Validate check configuration against actual predicates and examples.
Review actual check findings rather than accept them as decisions.
Resolve noncheckable issues and exceptions personally.

incremental.description: Maintain advisory predicates and fixtures as dialects and standards change.

approvals.approved_version: approved standards/check package v1 and named internal advisory locations; changed rules or enforcement scope void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Where standards still need repeated implementation and comparison, native configuration removes 8 setup hours and 14 comparison hours per provisional 100 task hours less 2 upkeep. Existing automated checks leave less manual work; authorship, final review, publication and exception judgement remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated definition and connector typing, with model semantics, tests and architectural decisions retained.
reach: Agree field/event meanings with warehouse and security colleagues.
skills_to_grow: Test retries, permissions and rollback independently
role.ambitious_version: An architect who uses native generation and checked drafts while keeping production and design authority explicit.
